## RuvNet Brain: ground rUv claims

Before stating a capability of Ruflo, RuVector/RVF, AgentDB, SPARC, agentic-flow, or
another rUv component, call `ruvnet-brain_search_ruvnet` and cite the exact returned
source path. Registration does not prove reachability or health; report unavailable or
inconclusive evidence instead of relying on model memory.

Agentic-kit manages the stable Brain MCP shim. Use `ak status` for managed state,
`ak sync` for updates, and `npx ruvnet-brain --doctor` for a health check.
